purpose: Non-admission targeted discovery of independent climate precipitation, disaster impact and official regional flood/landslide GIS sources not represented by matching candidate identities on OpenCatastrophe-data main or currently examined source research PRs. No source bytes, scientific validation or commercial-use rights are included.

entries.name: Climate Hazards Center CHIRPS version 3 precipitation estimates
entries.provider: UC Santa Barbara Climate Hazards Center
entries.spatial_scope: Land between 60 degrees N and 60 degrees S, all longitudes
entries.temporal_scope: 1981 to near present; preliminary pentads and monthly final version are different product states
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 0.05 degree gridded rain totals; native pentad/monthly with daily ERA5- or IMERG-disaggregated products; GeoTIFF, NetCDF, BIL and COG
entries.note: Distinct replacement product from CHIRPS v2 and not the NASA IMERG v07 data already in the register. Source page reports CC BY 4.0 and original data directory but exact licence, attribution and asset-scope review is pending. Daily rnl uses ERA5 and daily sat uses IMERG Late V07 for disaggregation: never count those as independent of their parent products. Pentad/monthly are the native source; use correct preliminary/final vintage and avoid interpreting downscaled daily timing as independent daily ground observations.

entries.name: Brazil Atlas Digital de Desastres municipal historical disaster and loss records
entries.provider: Brazil Secretaria Nacional de Protecao e Defesa Civil (SEDEC/MIDR) and CEPED/UFSC
entries.spatial_scope: Brazil, municipal and state reporting units
entries.temporal_scope: Official public portal describes 1991-2025 event records; the current download export's actual end date and monetary reference period require original-file verification
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Municipality, disaster type and reported impact; official Excel/semicolon-separated CSV, including monetary values corrected to December 2022 on the documented downloads page
entries.note: Government-reported civil-defense disaster and damage data, not insurer claims, insured TIV, physical footprints or independent ground truth. Preserve disaster taxonomy, municipality boundary vintage, event key, actual export date, currency and 2022 price-index conversion; verify missingness and manual correction logs before calibration. Provider publication/access and commercial redistribution terms have not been reviewed. Website may reject automated requests; no scraping bypass or provider bytes acquired.

entries.name: Ontario Emergency Management Historical Events vector catalogue
entries.provider: Government of Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources
entries.temporal_scope: Historical provincial events; source record exists since 2020, individual event years and completeness not yet profiled
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Vector event geometries; Ontario ArcGIS REST MapServer layer 20 and published complete zipped Shapefile/File Geodatabase products
entries.note: Official record lists dam failures, drought, erosion, floods, forest fires and soil/bedrock instability, but inclusion depends on involvement of Ontario emergency response officers: not a complete loss census. The catalogue states Open Government Licence - Ontario; check exact attribution, official metadata revision, layer geometry and true event timestamps before use. 'Structural loss' in description is not a quantified building-loss observation. No source bytes have been downloaded.

entries.name: Philippines MGB GDI Detailed Flood Susceptibility MapServer
entries.spatial_scope: Philippines, published service geographic footprint only; actual province/tile coverage unverified
entries.temporal_scope: Current public web service, production/model vintage not established
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ArcGIS REST MapServer with published service/layer metadata and cached map tiles; vector export or scientific class definitions not established
entries.note: Classified flood susceptibility is not observed event inundation, depth or return-period probability. Actual vector feature/query accessibility, legend class meaning, regional holes, vintage and licence require original-source review. Public map display does not establish permission for commercial modelling or bulk export. Keep distinct from BNPB Indonesia and PAGASA products.

entries.name: Philippines MGB GDI Detailed Rain-Induced Landslide Susceptibility MapServer
entries.spatial_scope: Philippines, published service geographic footprint only; actual coverage unverified
entries.temporal_scope: Current public service listing, hazard-model vintage not established
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Government ArcGIS REST MapServer layer listed in MGB GDI public service directory; underlying vector access and class definitions not yet tested
entries.note: The official MGB GDI directory lists this MapServer separately from the flood service; direct per-layer metadata was not retrieved in this research. Susceptibility is not an event footprint or probability of loss. Confirm published layer geometry, legend/classes, access terms, vintage and spatial completeness before any API probe, use or source admission.
